# ts-extended-errors

> Typed, serializable errors for TypeScript: a base class for custom errors, a
> one-line class factory, `cause`-chain helpers, and a JSON round trip that
> rebuilds the original classes. One package, `@rxova/ts-extended-errors`,
> published to GitHub Packages. Node >= 20.19, no runtime dependencies. MIT.
> Ships ESM and CommonJS.

This file is an index. It points to the files that document the package and
restates none of their content, so there is nothing here to drift from the
source.

## Packages

The package ships its `llms.txt` inside its tarball, so after an install it can
be read from `node_modules/@rxova/ts-extended-errors/llms.txt` with no network
access. Read it when writing code that uses the library.

- [@rxova/ts-extended-errors](packages/ts-extended-errors/llms.txt): the
  install setup, the API, a working example, and the mistakes to avoid.

## Docs

- [README](packages/ts-extended-errors/README.md): an example for every export,
  and tables for options and types. Also in the tarball.
- [GitHub Packages](https://github.com/rxova/ts-extended-errors/pkgs/npm/ts-extended-errors):
  the published versions.
